summary_en: 1,580,000 shares (4.2% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), ¥300M ceiling, open-market purchase on TSE, 17 June–16 July 2026. Stated rationale: enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency, enable future capital flexibility.
title_en: Notice of determination of matters relating to acquisition of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: SmartDrive announced on 16 June 2026 a buyback programme authorized under the Articles of Incorporation (Companies Act Article 165(3)). The company will acquire up to 1,580,000 common shares (4.2% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum of ¥300M via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 17 June and 16 July 2026. The issuer cited enhancement of shareholder returns, improvement in capital efficiency, and preservation of flexibility for future capital allocation as the rationale. The reference base for the percentage calculation is 37,632,852 shares outstanding ex-treasury as of the announcement date.
